legend: FNAB of a pathological lymph node in a 20-year-old man with a metastatic alveolar rhabdomyosarcoma (ARMS) of maxillary sinus. A direct smear (<<33013>>) showing a small, blue round cell neoplasia (Pap), which on immunocytochemistry of the cell block showed the myogenic markers desmin (<<33014>>) and myogenin (<<33015>>). FISH (not shown) demonstrated the rearrangement of the FOXO1 gene, confirming the ARMS diagnosis.
